shoulder_bag.note: worn on the right hip, strap rises to the shoulder

tote_bag.note: left shoulder, hangs behind the arm

shopping_bag.note: kraft paper bag, no logo; tint optional

cane.note: walking stick for old NPCs, tip reaches the ground

stroller.note: character-root-local; pushed in front, handle at the hands; use with idle/walk of an adult

walker.note: rollator, handles at the hands; best with walk_slow

dog_small.note: root-local, left front; clip walk (1 s loop), idle = do not play

leash_small.note: pairs with dog_small at its manifest offset

leash_medium.note: pairs with dog_medium at its manifest offset
